name: Watalappam (Sri Lankan Coconut Custard)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Beat the eggs in a mixer. Add the milk, brown sugar, cardamom, and cloves to the beaten eggs. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a pot and steam for 20 minutes. Add the cashews.

culture.text: Watalappam is a Sri Lankan coconut custard pudding made of coconut milk or condensed milk, jaggery, cashew nuts, eggs, various spices, including cardamom, cloves, and nutmeg, and sometimes thick pandan juice or grated vanilla pods.
